## Personality

Mirabel Cotton takes a distinct pride in her family history. Specifically, she is known to boast about her numerous deceased relatives and the various causes of their deaths.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007)_

## Traits

## History

Mirabel Cotton experienced significant loss in her family, having lost nearly all of her grandparents, uncles, and aunts. At school, she frightened [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith by sharing stories about her family's ghosts, leaving [Dora](../character/dora.md) afraid of the dark.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P1](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0001), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_
